comment: Reviewed third-party Go modules (ADR 0006 amendment 1, owner decision D-1, 2026-10-21). scripts/security-check.sh fails if backend/go.mod requires anything not listed here at exactly this version, or if the set of modules linked into the binaries differs from linked=true. Update only with a recorded review.

modules.notes: Pure-Go SQLite driver (D-1). Bundles SQLite 3.53.4 (public domain) transpiled to Go; third-party notices in its LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.md.
C runtime for the transpiled SQLite. Contains code derived from musl libc (MIT), Go (BSD-3-Clause), go-netdb (MIT) and nixpkgs (MIT); notices in its LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.md.
Includes code from mmap-go (BSD-3-Clause) and Go (BSD-3-Clause); LICENSE-MMAP-GO, LICENSE-GO.
In the module graph only; not compiled into any binary (go list -deps).
In the module graph only; not compiled into any binary (go list -deps).
OIDC ID token verification and discovery (ADR 0006 amendment 3). Linked into hc-api, and into hlctl because it imports internal/api; NOTICE (CoreOS) reproduced in third-party notices.
JWS/JWK for go-oidc (amendment 3). v4.1.7 chosen over go-oidc's minimum v4.1.4 for the GHSA fixes released in v4.1.5–v4.1.7; v4.1.8+ adds ML-DSA (not needed).

modules.notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code exchange with PKCE (amendment 3). Its cloud.google.com/go/compute/metadata requirement is outside the pruned module graph and not linked.
